product_metadata.title: WHOLE HOUSEWARES | Glass Canisters | Spice Jars | Bronze Cover and Lid | Set of 3 Canisters for Kitchen Organization | Food Storage containers (28/38/50oz)
features: If you're looking for a stylish and practical way to store your food, then look no further than our airtight glass storage containers. These jars keep ingredients visible on a table or shelf and are perfect for keeping sugar, coffee or tea fresh.

Their wide openings and screw on lids allow easy scooping and help maintain freshness. The touch window reminder lets you know when contents are running low and also makes it easy to quickly identify the contents. A better way to feature a dessert on your countertop.
They come in a set of 3 and are made of durable and thick glass, stainless steel and metal. With a capacity of 28/38/50 ounces, you can conveniently store various kitchen or pantry essentials.
These sleek and stylish canisters add a touch of elegance to your countertop. With its bronze cover and lid, it will surely stand out and give your kitchen that luxurious feel.
Our airtight glass canisters are a great way to display all your favorite types of sweets. The perfect storage solution for new homeowners. Makes a perfect gift for housewarming parties.
